ceremonies.title: Adopted the holder's OpenPGP key, stage one
ceremonies.summary: The existing primary was adopted as it is, with its history of subkeys: RSA-4096, no expiry. It now lives in an encrypted key file that a passkey on each root card opens. The adoption did not set the expiry that an adopted key should get: a later plan does it.
